title: Migrate roadmap and task source root
summary: Move roadmap task/sprint models, task boundary helpers, roadmap mutation logic, task tool execution, and roadmap generated-view integration into src/roadmap/**.

goal.outcome: Roadmap queue/task/sprint ownership lives under src/roadmap/** while codewiki_task behavior, task-boundary policy, and generated task views remain unchanged.
acceptance: Create src/roadmap/** owner modules for roadmap/task/sprint types, status helpers, task-id helpers, task-boundary assessment, roadmap file mutation, task create/update/close/cancel use cases, sprint metadata mutation, and codewiki_task tool execution.
Update state/resume/session/adapters/tests to import roadmap behavior from src/roadmap/** or stable public API paths.
Remove old roadmap/task owner paths or retain only explicit temporary shims with TASK-specific tests.
Preserve codewiki_task schema/result behavior, roadmap queue/archive JSON semantics, task context generation, task-boundary gates, package loading, direct Node execution, and smoke/feature coverage.
Add TASK-specific guard proving legacy roadmap/task imports are gone or explicitly shimmed.
non_goals: Do not migrate project, knowledge, session coordination, state/graph/resume internals, GC, change/diff-table, adapters/UI, or skills beyond roadmap consumer import updates.
Do not change roadmap JSON schema, task ids/status values, sprint metadata schema, task-close policy, package metadata, or public tool behavior.
